structure.purpose: Scoped agent procedures; judgment stays here rather than in shell glue.
Repository-wide operational harness and deterministic support code.
First Mate interoperability probes and the crew-orchestration harness.
Machine/device profile harnesses such as Android/Termux; separate from laptop crew readiness.
Portable deterministic contract and completeness tests.
Repository validators and operator entrypoints, primarily PowerShell.

commands.build: No product build is owned by this harness; run the selected project validator after a crew task.
commands.deploy: Not owned. This harness grants no deployment or live-target authority.

known_traps: Linux aarch64 availability is not Android/Termux proof.
Herdr is not a project manager; it is a session backend candidate.
First Mate is not the AgentSwitchboard control plane; it is a crew orchestration candidate.
Android readiness does not block productive laptop/WSL crew work; the lanes are independent.
Do not infer a valid Git checkout by requiring .git to be a directory; linked worktrees use a .git file.
Normalize equivalent GitHub origin transports before comparing repository identity.
Do not auto-promote Herdr while its pinned contract and live runtime gates are unresolved.
Do not use First Mate remote-writing modes until the local-only runtime gate has evidence.
Do not feed Windows temporary paths through wslpath and then parse combined native output; use WSLENV /p path translation and capture stdout/stderr separately.

A Windows-created linked worktree is not a portable Linux Git checkout because its .git indirection can contain Windows-owned worktree metadata. The bridge must create a WSL-owned standalone clone at the exact commit.
Do not hardcode /mnt/c for Windows-to-WSL transport; the WSL automount root is configurable.

Do not trust the implicit WSL default distribution for runtime execution. Enumerate installed distros, skip utility distros by default, require bash+git capability, and invoke the selected distro explicitly.

PowerShell here-strings can carry CRLF into bash -lc when Git materializes a script with Windows line endings. Normalize every WSL command payload from CRLF or CR to LF before adding it to ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList.

Native process stdout/stderr may legitimately be empty. PowerShell string parameters that receive those streams must declare AllowEmptyString before normalization or diagnostic inspection; otherwise parameter binding fails before the helper body can handle blank text.
A WSL configuration warning on stderr is diagnostic evidence, not machine-readable path or JSON output.

Do not discover a missing gh, tmux, python3, or GitHub-auth prerequisite after creating the WSL clone and running repository tests; the physical-floor wrapper must classify the prerequisite before clone/test work and emit the exact operator NEXT_ACTION.

A failed child pwsh invocation does not prevent later separately pasted PowerShell statements from running. Keep the physical success marker inside the prerequisite-gated wrapper and emit it only after the lower bridge returns exit zero.
